Message: /* select#1 */ select `ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_id` AS `order_id`,`ep2_lab`.`o`.`customer_id` AS `customer_id`,`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` AS `order_ts`,`ep2_lab`.`o`.`total_amount` AS `total_amount` from `ep2_lab`.`ep2_orders` `o` where ((`ep2_lab`.`o`.`status` = 'CREATED') and (`ep2_lab`.`o`.`store_id` = (@`store_id`)) and (`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` >= <cache>((@`long_start_ts`))) and (`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` < <cache>((@`end_ts`)))) order by `ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` desc,`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_id` desc limit 50
